name: oauth2-generator
description:
Generates an upstream credential and injects it into a configurable request header before forwarding the request to the backend.
Supports two mutually exclusive paths: exchanging client credentials for an access token via an OAuth2 grant (client_credentials or password), with automatic in-process/Redis caching and refresh, or injecting a directly supplied static bearer token. A token rejected by the upstream backend is purged from cache so the next request fetches a fresh one.
